modules.module_title: Prepare for installation at the site

pcs.pc_description: interpret the installation design layout for setting up the distributed antenna system
• verify the suitable distribution technology in the area of the installation site • technology: Cellular Signal Boosters, Active DAS, microcells
verify the installation tool kit is available and is in a working condition
check the installation site is free of any obstruction
check the compatibility and usability of the hardware received for commissioning
wear the PPE kit before the installation process
arrange UPS backup to the devices in case of power failure

modules.module_title: Install cellular signal boosters at the site

pcs.pc_description: install the donor antenna at the top of the building at the right direction to receive cellular signals (different antenna for different carriers)
connect bidirectional amplifier (BDA) to signal source via co-axial cables to receive and amplify signals
Install the couplers at the designated area in the building to receive signal from BDA and split the signals in a specific ratio
use splitters at the designated area to divide the signals further and distribute to other areas within the building
use attenuators to adjust the signal strength and balance the signal levels in the system
Install terminations to prevent signal degradation and interference
test the signal strength and quality

modules.module_title: Install Distributed Antenna Systems at the site

pcs.pc_description: install DAS Headend Unit (contains amplifiers, filters, combiners and distribution modules) or the central hub which receives wireless signals from the base station (signal source) and distribute them to the Remote Units (contains amplifiers, filters and signal processing components)
connect the HEU to the base station (signal source) via fiber optic or coaxial cable (could be on a roof top or indoor)
install the antennas in strategic locations inside the building to receive and transmit signals throughout the building
connect the antennas to the remote units using a coaxial cable to carry amplified signals
use the Power Supply units to provide power to the components of the Active DAS system
install the system controller software to manage and monitor the Active DAS System

modules.module_title: Install additional Microcells to the existing network

pcs.pc_description: determine the number of cells required based on the coverage
identify the location where the microcell needs to be installed
mount the small cells on poles or secure them to the structure through bolts or clamps in the identified location
provide power source to the small cells through a power cable
connect the small cells to the existing network to provide coverage
configure the small cells to work with existing network with appropriate software
test and optimize to ensure they are providing intended coverage

modules.module_title: Configure the devices in the network

pcs.pc_description: verify the installed devices are switched on and operational
Install the device configuration software in the laptop/desktop
configure the central hub for appropriate signal frequency and power levels
configure the remote units to receive and amplify signals correctly
configure the antennas to provide optimal coverage and excellent signal strength
configure the amplifiers to ensure they are amplifying signals to the desired level
configure the cables to minimize signal loss and interference

modules.module_title: Test the working of the connectivity

pcs.pc_description: check the devices are plugged to the power source and cables are secured
use cable tester or media tester to check if the cables are working properly or not
measure the reflected signal quality or loss of signal using Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR used for copper connections) or Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR used for optical fiber connections)
use a power meter to measure the power levels at various points in the DAS system
Conduct the Sweep (frequency sweep, sine sweep) Test and PIM (Passive Intermodulation Distortion) to check the quality of the signal transmitted
Use a spectrum analyzer to measure noise levels at various points throughout the building
verify the latest version of the software is installed in all the devices in DAS
check the configuration settings of all devices in DAS system
test the communication between the HEU, remote units and other components to ensure they are properly connected and are communicating to each other
perform load testing to ensure the system can handle expected amount of traffic and usage
perform stress testing to ensure the system can handle unexpected spikes in traffic and usage
maintain user manuals, installation guides and technical specifications for DAS system
maintain the support document for future expansion of the system by adding more devices
maintain the asset details with their nomenclature
work closely with DAS vendor to get onsite, remote or telephonic technical support
provide training for staff members responsible for maintaining the DAS system
• keep detailed records of all aspects of DAS system for future reference • records: installation, maintenance, upgrade and repairs
document maintenance schedule (daily, weekly, monthly schedule)
